A full card image with the corrected text set into the card and a small bronze disc at the bottom right, beside the game-text box, marking it as errata. The Players Committee showed it in its online card lists; the earliest saved copy is from 24 January 2018. Disc images of other cards were saved from May 2013, so this image may be older than its first saved copy.

== What changed on the image ==
[[File:Hoth-L-rebelscout-PC-Errata-disc-changes.png|none|900px|Before and after]]
Compared with [[Rebel Scout (PC Errata 2017 slip)]] (31 May 2017): Same words as the 2017 slip. This is a full card image with the printed art, lore and title. There is no title strip and no “E”; a small round bronze disc sits at the bottom right, beside the game-text box.

The 2017 slip and the same area of the disc card, scaled to the slip's width; nothing else is edited.
